entries.title: Dandara
entries.definitive_edition: Dandara: Trials of Fear Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Trials of Fear Edition content.

primary.why: Trials of Fear Edition is the definitive route because it is a free, bigger version with new areas, boss, powers, ability, story material, music, and a secret ending. The Windows PC version keeps that complete edition while giving the best capture/settings route for an archive playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dandara: Trials of Fear Edition on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.
